title: Who needs Dolby Atmos? These 6 4K Blu-rays support with DTS Master Audio surround sound (and 1 with stereo) are perfect for showing off what your your home theater can really do
excerpt: While Dolby Atmos may have the name-power, I've found its rival is no slouch either, so I picked my top 7 DTS 4K Blu-rays.
content_html:
Dolby Atmos gets plaudits as the more popular immersive 3D sound format, but a lot of its love from home theater enthusiasts isn't about the spatial audio, but is more about the lossless audio quality you get on 4K Blu-ray. It's not the only game in town for this, however: there's also DTS-HD Master Audio (MA).

I’ve been testing new 4K Blu-rays as part of the Blu-ray Bounty, my monthly feature where I review the best new 4K releases for sound and visual quality, and tons of them use DTS-HD MA — especially older titles.

While DTS isn’t supported as widely in hardware as Dolby Atmos (new-release LG and Samsung TVs don't support DTS, for example), it’s an excellent sound format that can still deliver an immersive surround sound experience, especially in 5.1 surround systems.

While DTS-HD MA may not utilize height channels like Dolby Atmos does, there are a few 4K Blu-rays I’ve tested whose DTS-HD MA soundtracks sound so good, they had me asking who needs Dolby Atmos height effects anyway.

Below, I’ve picked seven of my favorite 4K discs that feature brilliant DTS soundtracks — most are 5.1 surround sound, but one is actually stereo (as the creator intended).

What do you think of Dolby Atmos vs DTS? Any other DTS 4K discs you think people should check out? Be sure to let us know in the comments below!

Chungking Express

Chungking Express follows the separate stories of two policemen in Hong Kong, both of whom are going through breakups and meet new strangers.

Where the DTS-HD 5.1 MA soundtrack shines here is capturing the hustle and bustle of Hong Kong. During one scene where Ah Wu (Cop 223) enters a night market, the sound of raised voices, goods being exchanged and the general chaos of a busy market sounds realistic and detailed.

The surround channels are used to full effect and sound is accurately mapped to them. The movement of sound had me double-checking the room, the sounds of the market are so convincing and tactile.

A later scene where Cop 663 visits a restaurant, the conversation of the patrons, clinking glasses and cutlery being used are given ample room to breathe, and the sound placement is precise. Again, the scene had that immersive feel that I’d found during the aforementioned night market scene. Throughout, the jazzy score is well balanced with other elements in the mix.

Tombstone

Tombstone follows the story of Wyatt Earp (Kurt Russell), a retired lawman who moves to the titular town with his brothers Virgil (Sam Elliott) and Morgan (Bill Paxton), and along with Doc Holliday (Val Kilmer) they must defend the town from a group of outlaws.

As you’d expect from a Western, there’s plenty of gunfights that demonstrate excellent surround sound and dynamic range. The DTS-HD 5.1 MA soundtrack here accurately maps ricocheting bullets to rear channels, while also following their trajectory. There’s good impact from said bullets too, showing some nice power from the front channels.

Elsewhere, other effects such as the clinking of spurs have a bright, clear sound and again sound realistic, with a clear connection between the sound and the action. Whenever horses gallop, there’s some meaty bass that delivers a solid rumble. The subwoofer of the system I use delivered plenty of oomph that even made our testing lab shake. Crucially though, despite bass volume, it’s well controlled and balanced within the mix.

Dunkirk

Dunkirk, directed by Christopher Nolan, follows the events of the Dunkirk evacuation in WWII, told from three different perspectives of people in the land, sea and air. It stars an ensemble cast that includes Kenneth Branagh, Tom Hardy and Cillian Murphy.

Christopher Nolan notably never uses Dolby Atmos with his movies, and Dunkirk is no different. While any Nolan movie could make this list (and this isn’t the only one), Dunkirk is easily one of the most impressive.

In the opening scenes, as the British soldiers attempt to outrun the gunfire, the mapping and directionality of the bullets was pinpoint accurate, coming from behind my head and ramping up the anxiety. These bullets also had plenty of impact and punch, delivering some serious power with every hit.

This is another DTS mix that despite a lack of height channels, delivers enough immersion that it feels like there’s height. Anytime a plane flies overhead, there’s absolutely perceived height, and the drone of the plane's engines has a clear sense of direction. Throughout the movie, bass levels are powerful but well controlled and dynamic, really giving a subwoofer a workout.

Interstellar

Interstellar is the story of Coop (Matthew McConaughey), a NASA pilot who joins an expedition to find a new home for humans, as Earth succumbs to famine and crisis. The movie also stars Anne Hathaway, Jessica Chastain and Michael Caine among its cast list.

Christopher Nolan’s second movie on the list, Interstellar delivers an impressive showcase for DTS-HD 5.1 MA. As the Endurance navigates the Gargantua wormhole, bass levels are strong, but there’s an added (intentional) sense of direction to the low frequencies as well, as the sound moves from the front to the rear speakers to create a fully immersive and engaging sense of reality bending around you. The roar of the ship’s engines delivers a seriously powerful rumble too, showing what your subwoofer can do.

There’s some fantastic detail within the sound mix too. During Coop’s daring docking sequence with the out-of-control Endurance, the sound of debris crunching into the ship and the directionality of the spinning ships are all intricate, audible and precise. There’s an excellent balance between every element, even with the powerful, organ-led score over the top of it — this is a really tough scene for speakers to drive, and is a great showcase for why Blu-ray is superior to streaming: it sounds so much weaker from any streaming source, but is brilliantly overwhelming here.

As Coop encouncters the black hole, the rattling sound of the dust again scrapes along the outside of the ship convincingly and sharply, really putting me inside the Ranger ship myself.

Minority Report

Minority Report, loosely based on Philip K Dick’s novella The Minority Report, stars Tom Cruise as John Anderton, the chief of the Precrime unit, which uses clairvoyant people to predict homicides before they happen. When the clairvoyant ‘precogs’ predict that Anderton will commit a homicide, he must go on the run.

Despite the lack of height channels in the DTS-HD 5.1 MA soundtrack featured on the Minority Report 4K Blu-ray, there are plenty of scenes where a sense of height is created. During the jetpack fight scene, the movement of sound and the spatial elements within the scene are enough to create the feeling of height to the mix.

The same is true in another scene where John escapes along a magnetic car freeway. Cars over John’s head, as he scales up the automated lanes of traffic, sound like they’re coming overhead, even with the missing height channels in the mix.

The detail in this disc’s soundtrack is just excellent. Other elements such as punches during fight scenes deliver solid impact and heft, with some meaty bass as well.

Fight Club

Fight Club is the story of an unnamed narrator (Edward Norton), who's an insurance agent who meets a mysterious soap salesman named Tyler Durden (Brad Pitt) and starts an underground fight club for disillusioned people.

As you’d hope from a movie as gritty as this, there’s plenty to like about the 4K disc’s DTS-HD 5.1 MA soundtrack. During fight scenes, punches and collisions have real impact, feeling every bit as gruelling as the scenes themselves. More visceral sounds, such as the bag of fat splitting open, are gruesome and realistic, sounding worryingly detailed. The narrator’s speech is crystal clear throughout most of the movie too, balancing well with the score and other effects.

Again, this is another mix with a real immersive feel in some scenes, delivering perceived height effects. During the opening, as the camera drops down through the building where the narrator is held at gunpoint, to the parking garage below, the sound of the breeze accurately follows the trajectory of the camera, creating that sense of height despite the lack of height channels.

Blow Out

Blow Out follows Jack Terry (John Travolta), a sound technician who is embroiled in a murder/assassination plot when he inadvertently captures evidence of the assassination while recording audio for a low-budget slasher film he’s involved in.

What makes this disc’s soundtrack so interesting is that rather than DTS-HD 5.1 MA surround, which the other entries in this list have been, this uses a DTS-HD 2.0 surround mix, preserving the original presentation, but in the best-quality mix we can deliver today.

While stereo may sound limited, some excellent sound design means the movie absolutely feels immersive. This is best demonstrated during a scene where Jack records audio in the park near the opening of the movie.

As he aims his microphone to capture audio, the sound of the wind and distant traffic fills the space with subtlety. When louder audio comes in, such as the hooting of an owl, the other effects don’t go away. As the car swerves off the bridge, the sound of the screeching tyres moves from side to side, again utilizing the surround channels well. There’s still some good impact as the car crashes through the fence into the river, too.

sentences.zh: 正如您对西部片的期望，有大量的枪战展示了出色的环绕声和动态范围。

sentences.en: The DTS-HD 5.1 MA soundtrack here accurately maps ricocheting bullets to rear channels, while also following their trajectory.
sentences.zh: 这里的 DTS-HD 5.1 MA 配乐将弹跳的子弹准确地映射到后声道，同时也跟踪它们的轨迹。

sentences.en: There’s good impact from said bullets too, showing some nice power from the front channels.
sentences.zh: 所述子弹也具有良好的影响力，显示出来自前通道的一些不错的力量。

blocks.html_en: Elsewhere, other effects such as the clinking of spurs have a bright, clear sound and again sound realistic, with a clear connection between the sound and the action. Whenever horses gallop, there’s some meaty bass that delivers a solid rumble. The subwoofer of the system I use delivered plenty of oomph that even made our testing lab shake. Crucially though, despite bass volume, it’s well controlled and balanced within the mix.

sentences.en: Elsewhere, other effects such as the clinking of spurs have a bright, clear sound and again sound realistic, with a clear connection between the sound and the action.
sentences.zh: 在其他地方，其他效果，例如马刺的叮当声，具有明亮、清晰的声音，而且听起来很逼真，声音和动作之间有清晰的联系。

sentences.en: Whenever horses gallop, there’s some meaty bass that delivers a solid rumble.
sentences.zh: 每当马匹驰骋时，就会有一些肉质的低音发出坚实的隆隆声。

sentences.en: The subwoofer of the system I use delivered plenty of oomph that even made our testing lab shake.
sentences.zh: 我使用的系统的低音炮提供了足够的魅力，甚至让我们的测试实验室感到震惊。

sentences.en: Crucially though, despite bass volume, it’s well controlled and balanced within the mix.
sentences.zh: 但至关重要的是，尽管低音音量很大，但它在混音中得到了很好的控制和平衡。

blocks.html_en: Dunkirk, directed by Christopher Nolan, follows the events of the Dunkirk evacuation in WWII, told from three different perspectives of people in the land, sea and air. It stars an ensemble cast that includes Kenneth Branagh, Tom Hardy and Cillian Murphy.

sentences.en: Dunkirk, directed by Christopher Nolan, follows the events of the Dunkirk evacuation in WWII, told from three different perspectives of people in the land, sea and air.
sentences.zh: 《敦刻尔克》由克里斯托弗·诺兰执导，讲述了二战敦刻尔克大撤退事件，从陆地、海上和空中三个不同的角度讲述了人们的故事。

sentences.en: It stars an ensemble cast that includes Kenneth Branagh, Tom Hardy and Cillian Murphy.
sentences.zh: 该片由肯尼思·布拉纳、汤姆·哈迪和希里安·墨菲等众多演员主演。

blocks.html_en: Christopher Nolan notably never uses Dolby Atmos with his movies, and Dunkirk is no different. While any Nolan movie could make this list (and this isn’t the only one), Dunkirk is easily one of the most impressive.

sentences.en: Christopher Nolan notably never uses Dolby Atmos with his movies, and Dunkirk is no different.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，克里斯托弗·诺兰 (Christopher Nolan) 从未在他的电影中使用杜比全景声 (Dolby Atmos)，《敦刻尔克》也不例外。

sentences.en: While any Nolan movie could make this list (and this isn’t the only one), Dunkirk is easily one of the most impressive.
sentences.zh: 虽然任何诺兰电影都可以进入这个名单（这不是唯一一部），但《敦刻尔克》无疑是最令人印象深刻的电影之一。

blocks.html_en: In the opening scenes, as the British soldiers attempt to outrun the gunfire, the mapping and directionality of the bullets was pinpoint accurate, coming from behind my head and ramping up the anxiety. These bullets also had plenty of impact and punch, delivering some serious power with every hit.

sentences.en: In the opening scenes, as the British soldiers attempt to outrun the gunfire, the mapping and directionality of the bullets was pinpoint accurate, coming from behind my head and ramping up the anxiety.
sentences.zh: 在开场场景中，当英国士兵试图逃离枪林弹雨时，子弹的映射和方向非常准确，从我的脑后射来，加剧了我的焦虑。

sentences.en: These bullets also had plenty of impact and punch, delivering some serious power with every hit.
sentences.zh: 这些子弹还具有足够的冲击力和冲击力，每次击中都会产生强大的威力。

blocks.html_en: This is another DTS mix that despite a lack of height channels, delivers enough immersion that it feels like there’s height. Anytime a plane flies overhead, there’s absolutely perceived height, and the drone of the plane's engines has a clear sense of direction. Throughout the movie, bass levels are powerful but well controlled and dynamic, really giving a subwoofer a workout.

sentences.en: This is another DTS mix that despite a lack of height channels, delivers enough immersion that it feels like there’s height.
sentences.zh: 这是另一种 DTS 混音，尽管缺乏高度通道，但提供了足够的沉浸感，让人感觉有高度。

sentences.en: Anytime a plane flies overhead, there’s absolutely perceived height, and the drone of the plane's engines has a clear sense of direction.
sentences.zh: 每当飞机飞过头顶时，都会有绝对的感知高度，并且飞机发动机的嗡嗡声具有清晰的方向感。

sentences.en: Throughout the movie, bass levels are powerful but well controlled and dynamic, really giving a subwoofer a workout.
sentences.zh: 在整部电影中，低音水平强劲，但控制良好且充满活力，确实给低音炮带来了锻炼。

blocks.html_en: Interstellar

sentences.en: Interstellar
sentences.zh: 星际穿越

sentences.en: (Image credit: Warner Bros. / Future)
sentences.zh: （图片来源：华纳兄弟/未来）

blocks.html_en: Interstellar is the story of Coop (Matthew McConaughey), a NASA pilot who joins an expedition to find a new home for humans, as Earth succumbs to famine and crisis. The movie also stars Anne Hathaway, Jessica Chastain and Michael Caine among its cast list.

sentences.en: Interstellar is the story of Coop (Matthew McConaughey), a NASA pilot who joins an expedition to find a new home for humans, as Earth succumbs to famine and crisis.
sentences.zh: 《星际穿越》讲述了库普（马修·麦康纳饰）的故事，他是一名美国宇航局飞行员，在地球陷入饥荒和危机之际，他加入了一场为人类寻找新家园的探险队。

sentences.en: The movie also stars Anne Hathaway, Jessica Chastain and Michael Caine among its cast list.
sentences.zh: 这部电影的演员名单中还包括安妮·海瑟薇、杰西卡·查斯坦和迈克尔·凯恩。

blocks.html_en: Christopher Nolan’s second movie on the list, Interstellar delivers an impressive showcase for DTS-HD 5.1 MA. As the Endurance navigates the Gargantua wormhole, bass levels are strong, but there’s an added (intentional) sense of direction to the low frequencies as well, as the sound moves from the front to the rear speakers to create a fully immersive and engaging sense of reality bending around you. The roar of the ship’s engines delivers a seriously powerful rumble too, showing what your subwoofer can do.

sentences.en: Christopher Nolan’s second movie on the list, Interstellar delivers an impressive showcase for DTS-HD 5.1 MA.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗·诺兰上榜的第二部电影《星际穿越》为 DTS-HD 5.1 MA 带来了令人印象深刻的展示。

sentences.en: As the Endurance navigates the Gargantua wormhole, bass levels are strong, but there’s an added (intentional) sense of direction to the low frequencies as well, as the sound moves from the front to the rear speakers to create a fully immersive and engaging sense of reality bending around you.
sentences.zh: 当 Endurance 在 Gargantua 虫洞中航行时，低音水平很强，但低频也有一种额外的（有意的）方向感，因为声音从前置扬声器移动到后置扬声器，营造出一种完全身临其境、引人入胜的现实感，在您周围弯曲。

sentences.en: The roar of the ship’s engines delivers a seriously powerful rumble too, showing what your subwoofer can do.
sentences.zh: 船舶发动机的轰鸣声也发出非常强大的隆隆声，展示了低音炮的功能。

blocks.html_en: There’s some fantastic detail within the sound mix too. During Coop’s daring docking sequence with the out-of-control Endurance, the sound of debris crunching into the ship and the directionality of the spinning ships are all intricate, audible and precise. There’s an excellent balance between every element, even with the powerful, organ-led score over the top of it — this is a really tough scene for speakers to drive, and is a great showcase for why Blu-ray is superior to streaming: it sounds so much weaker from any streaming source, but is brilliantly overwhelming here.

sentences.en: There’s some fantastic detail within the sound mix too.
sentences.zh: 混音中也有一些奇妙的细节。

sentences.en: During Coop’s daring docking sequence with the out-of-control Endurance, the sound of debris crunching into the ship and the directionality of the spinning ships are all intricate, audible and precise.
sentences.zh: 在库普与失控的耐力号进行大胆对接的过程中，碎片撞击船的声音以及旋转船的方向都是复杂的、可听见的和精确的。

sentences.en: There’s an excellent balance between every element, even with the powerful, organ-led score over the top of it — this is a really tough scene for speakers to drive, and is a great showcase for why Blu-ray is superior to streaming: it sounds so much weaker from any streaming source, but is brilliantly overwhelming here.
sentences.zh: 每个元素之间都有着出色的平衡，即使是在其顶部有强大的、风琴主导的配乐——这对于扬声器来说是一个非常难以驱动的场景，并且很好地展示了为什么蓝光优于流媒体：它从任何流媒体源听起来都弱得多，但在这里却非常出色。

blocks.html_en: As Coop encouncters the black hole, the rattling sound of the dust again scrapes along the outside of the ship convincingly and sharply, really putting me inside the Ranger ship myself.

sentences.en: As Coop encouncters the black hole, the rattling sound of the dust again scrapes along the outside of the ship convincingly and sharply, really putting me inside the Ranger ship myself.
sentences.zh: 当库普遇到黑洞时，灰尘的嘎嘎声再次令人信服地尖锐地沿着船的外部刮擦，真的让我自己进入了游侠船。

blocks.html_en: Minority Report, loosely based on Philip K Dick’s novella The Minority Report, stars Tom Cruise as John Anderton, the chief of the Precrime unit, which uses clairvoyant people to predict homicides before they happen. When the clairvoyant ‘precogs’ predict that Anderton will commit a homicide, he must go on the run.

sentences.en: Minority Report, loosely based on Philip K Dick’s novella The Minority Report, stars Tom Cruise as John Anderton, the chief of the Precrime unit, which uses clairvoyant people to predict homicides before they happen.

sentences.en: When the clairvoyant ‘precogs’ predict that Anderton will commit a homicide, he must go on the run.

blocks.html_en: Despite the lack of height channels in the DTS-HD 5.1 MA soundtrack featured on the Minority Report 4K Blu-ray, there are plenty of scenes where a sense of height is created. During the jetpack fight scene, the movement of sound and the spatial elements within the scene are enough to create the feeling of height to the mix.

sentences.en: Despite the lack of height channels in the DTS-HD 5.1 MA soundtrack featured on the Minority Report 4K Blu-ray, there are plenty of scenes where a sense of height is created.
sentences.zh: 尽管《少数派报告》4K 蓝光光盘中的 DTS-HD 5.1 MA 原声带缺乏高度声道，但仍有大量场景营造出高度感。

sentences.en: During the jetpack fight scene, the movement of sound and the spatial elements within the scene are enough to create the feeling of height to the mix.
sentences.zh: 在喷气背包战斗场景中，声音的移动和场景中的空间元素足以营造混音的高度感。

blocks.html_en: The same is true in another scene where John escapes along a magnetic car freeway. Cars over John’s head, as he scales up the automated lanes of traffic, sound like they’re coming overhead, even with the missing height channels in the mix.

sentences.en: The same is true in another scene where John escapes along a magnetic car freeway.
sentences.zh: 约翰沿着磁性汽车高速公路逃跑的另一个场景也是如此。

sentences.en: Cars over John’s head, as he scales up the automated lanes of traffic, sound like they’re coming overhead, even with the missing height channels in the mix.
sentences.zh: 当约翰扩大自动车道时，汽车在他的头顶上飞过，听起来就像它们从头顶驶过，即使混合中缺少高度通道。

blocks.html_en: The detail in this disc’s soundtrack is just excellent. Other elements such as punches during fight scenes deliver solid impact and heft, with some meaty bass as well.

sentences.en: The detail in this disc’s soundtrack is just excellent.
sentences.zh: 这张唱片的配乐细节非常出色。

sentences.en: Other elements such as punches during fight scenes deliver solid impact and heft, with some meaty bass as well.
sentences.zh: 其他元素，例如战斗场景中的拳击，提供了坚实的冲击力和分量，还有一些肉质的低音。

blocks.html_en: Fight Club is the story of an unnamed narrator (Edward Norton), who's an insurance agent who meets a mysterious soap salesman named Tyler Durden (Brad Pitt) and starts an underground fight club for disillusioned people.

sentences.en: Fight Club is the story of an unnamed narrator (Edward Norton), who's an insurance agent who meets a mysterious soap salesman named Tyler Durden (Brad Pitt) and starts an underground fight club for disillusioned people.
sentences.zh: 《搏击俱乐部》讲述了一位不知名的叙述者（爱德华·诺顿饰）的故事，他是一名保险代理人，遇到了一位名叫泰勒·德登（布拉德·皮特饰）的神秘肥皂推销员，并为幻灭的人们创办了一个地下搏击俱乐部。

blocks.html_en: As you’d hope from a movie as gritty as this, there’s plenty to like about the 4K disc’s DTS-HD 5.1 MA soundtrack. During fight scenes, punches and collisions have real impact, feeling every bit as gruelling as the scenes themselves. More visceral sounds, such as the bag of fat splitting open, are gruesome and realistic, sounding worryingly detailed. The narrator’s speech is crystal clear throughout most of the movie too, balancing well with the score and other effects.

sentences.en: As you’d hope from a movie as gritty as this, there’s plenty to like about the 4K disc’s DTS-HD 5.1 MA soundtrack.

sentences.en: During fight scenes, punches and collisions have real impact, feeling every bit as gruelling as the scenes themselves.

blocks.html_en: Blow Out follows Jack Terry (John Travolta), a sound technician who is embroiled in a murder/assassination plot when he inadvertently captures evidence of the assassination while recording audio for a low-budget slasher film he’s involved in.

sentences.en: Blow Out follows Jack Terry (John Travolta), a sound technician who is embroiled in a murder/assassination plot when he inadvertently captures evidence of the assassination while recording audio for a low-budget slasher film he’s involved in.
sentences.zh: 《井喷》讲述了杰克·特里（约翰·特拉沃尔塔饰）是一名音响技术员，他在为自己参与的一部低成本恐怖电影录制音频时无意中捕捉到了暗杀证据，从而卷入了一场谋杀/暗杀阴谋。

blocks.html_en: What makes this disc’s soundtrack so interesting is that rather than DTS-HD 5.1 MA surround, which the other entries in this list have been, this uses a DTS-HD 2.0 surround mix, preserving the original presentation, but in the best-quality mix we can deliver today.

sentences.en: What makes this disc’s soundtrack so interesting is that rather than DTS-HD 5.1 MA surround, which the other entries in this list have been, this uses a DTS-HD 2.0 surround mix, preserving the original presentation, but in the best-quality mix we can deliver today.
sentences.zh: 这张光盘的配乐如此有趣的原因在于，它使用的是 DTS-HD 2.0 环绕混音，而不是此列表中其他条目所采用的 DTS-HD 5.1 MA 环绕混音，保留了原始演示，但采用了我们今天可以提供的最佳质量混音。

blocks.html_en: While stereo may sound limited, some excellent sound design means the movie absolutely feels immersive. This is best demonstrated during a scene where Jack records audio in the park near the opening of the movie.

sentences.en: While stereo may sound limited, some excellent sound design means the movie absolutely feels immersive.

content_html_zh:
杜比全景声 (Dolby Atmos) 作为更流行的沉浸式 3D 声音格式而广受赞誉，但家庭影院爱好者对它的喜爱并不在于空间音频，而更多在于 4K 蓝光上获得的无损音频质量。 然而，这并不是唯一的游戏：还有 DTS-HD Master Audio (MA)。

作为蓝光赏金计划的一部分，我一直在测试新的 4K 蓝光光盘，这是我的每月专题，我会在其中回顾最佳的新 4K 版本的声音和视觉质量，其中大量使用 DTS-HD MA，尤其是较旧的游戏。

虽然 DTS 在硬件上的支持不如杜比全景声（例如，新发布的 LG 和三星电视不支持 DTS），但它是一种出色的声音格式，仍然可以提供身临其境的环绕声体验，尤其是在 5.1 环绕声系统中。

虽然 DTS-HD MA 可能不会像杜比全景声 (Dolby Atmos) 那样利用高度声道，但我测试过一些 4K 蓝光，其 DTS-HD MA 音轨听起来非常好，它们让我问谁需要杜比全景声 (Dolby Atmos) 高度效果。

下面，我挑选了七张我最喜欢的 4K 光盘，它们具有出色的 DTS 音轨 - 大多数是 5.1 环绕声，但其中一张实际上是立体声（正如创作者的意图）。

您如何看待杜比全景声 (Dolby Atmos) 与 DTS？ 您认为人们应该看看其他任何 DTS 4K 光盘吗？ 请务必在下面的评论中告诉我们！

重庆森林

《重庆森林》讲述了香港两名警察的不同故事，他们都经历了分手并结识了新的陌生人。

订阅突发新闻、评论、观点、顶级技术交易等。

DTS-HD 5.1 MA 配乐的亮点在于捕捉了香港的喧嚣。 在阿武（第 223 警察）进入夜市的场景中，提高的声音、交换物品的声音以及繁忙市场的普遍混乱听起来真实而细致。

环绕声道被充分利用，声音被准确地映射到它们。 声音的移动让我仔细检查了房间，市场的声音是如此令人信服和有触觉。

后来663警察参观餐厅的场景，顾客的谈话、玻璃杯和餐具的叮当声都有足够的呼吸空间，声音的定位也很精确。 再次，这个场景有我在前面提到的夜市场景中找到的那种身临其境的感觉。 自始至终，爵士乐配乐与混音中的其他元素保持着良好的平衡。

墓碑

《墓碑镇》讲述了怀亚特·厄普（库尔特·拉塞尔饰）的故事，他是一位退休执法者，与他的兄弟维吉尔（山姆·艾略特饰）和摩根（比尔·帕克斯顿饰）搬到了这个名义上的小镇，并与霍利迪医生（方·基尔默饰）一起保卫小镇免受一群不法分子的侵害。

正如您对西部片的期望，有大量的枪战展示了出色的环绕声和动态范围。 这里的 DTS-HD 5.1 MA 配乐将弹跳的子弹准确地映射到后声道，同时也跟踪它们的轨迹。 所述子弹也具有良好的影响力，显示出来自前通道的一些不错的力量。

在其他地方，其他效果，例如马刺的叮当声，具有明亮、清晰的声音，而且听起来很逼真，声音和动作之间有清晰的联系。 每当马匹驰骋时，就会有一些肉质的低音发出坚实的隆隆声。 我使用的系统的低音炮提供了足够的魅力，甚至让我们的测试实验室感到震惊。 但至关重要的是，尽管低音音量很大，但它在混音中得到了很好的控制和平衡。

敦刻尔克

《敦刻尔克》由克里斯托弗·诺兰执导，讲述了二战敦刻尔克大撤退事件，从陆地、海上和空中三个不同的角度讲述了人们的故事。 该片由肯尼思·布拉纳、汤姆·哈迪和希里安·墨菲等众多演员主演。

值得注意的是，克里斯托弗·诺兰 (Christopher Nolan) 从未在他的电影中使用杜比全景声 (Dolby Atmos)，《敦刻尔克》也不例外。 虽然任何诺兰电影都可以进入这个名单（这不是唯一一部），但《敦刻尔克》无疑是最令人印象深刻的电影之一。

在开场场景中，当英国士兵试图逃离枪林弹雨时，子弹的映射和方向非常准确，从我的脑后射来，加剧了我的焦虑。 这些子弹还具有足够的冲击力和冲击力，每次击中都会产生强大的威力。

这是另一种 DTS 混音，尽管缺乏高度通道，但提供了足够的沉浸感，让人感觉有高度。 每当飞机飞过头顶时，都会有绝对的感知高度，并且飞机发动机的嗡嗡声具有清晰的方向感。 在整部电影中，低音水平强劲，但控制良好且充满活力，确实给低音炮带来了锻炼。

星际穿越

《星际穿越》讲述了库普（马修·麦康纳饰）的故事，他是一名美国宇航局飞行员，在地球陷入饥荒和危机之际，他加入了一场为人类寻找新家园的探险队。 这部电影的演员名单中还包括安妮·海瑟薇、杰西卡·查斯坦和迈克尔·凯恩。

克里斯托弗·诺兰上榜的第二部电影《星际穿越》为 DTS-HD 5.1 MA 带来了令人印象深刻的展示。 当 Endurance 在 Gargantua 虫洞中航行时，低音水平很强，但低频也有一种额外的（有意的）方向感，因为声音从前置扬声器移动到后置扬声器，营造出一种完全身临其境、引人入胜的现实感，在您周围弯曲。 船舶发动机的轰鸣声也发出非常强大的隆隆声，展示了低音炮的功能。

混音中也有一些奇妙的细节。 在库普与失控的耐力号进行大胆对接的过程中，碎片撞击船的声音以及旋转船的方向都是复杂的、可听见的和精确的。 每个元素之间都有着出色的平衡，即使是在其顶部有强大的、风琴主导的配乐——这对于扬声器来说是一个非常难以驱动的场景，并且很好地展示了为什么蓝光优于流媒体：它从任何流媒体源听起来都弱得多，但在这里却非常出色。

当库普遇到黑洞时，灰尘的嘎嘎声再次令人信服地尖锐地沿着船的外部刮擦，真的让我自己进入了游侠船。

少数派报告

《少数派报告》大致改编自菲利普·K·迪克的中篇小说《少数派报告》，汤姆·克鲁斯饰演预防犯罪部门的负责人约翰·安德顿，该部门利用具有千里眼的人来预测凶杀案的发生。 当具有千里眼的“预知者”预测安德顿将犯下杀人罪时，他必须逃跑。

尽管《少数派报告》4K 蓝光光盘中的 DTS-HD 5.1 MA 原声带缺乏高度声道，但仍有大量场景营造出高度感。 在喷气背包战斗场景中，声音的移动和场景中的空间元素足以营造混音的高度感。

约翰沿着磁性汽车高速公路逃跑的另一个场景也是如此。 当约翰扩大自动车道时，汽车在他的头顶上飞过，听起来就像它们从头顶驶过，即使混合中缺少高度通道。

这张唱片的配乐细节非常出色。 其他元素，例如战斗场景中的拳击，提供了坚实的冲击力和分量，还有一些肉质的低音。

搏击俱乐部

《搏击俱乐部》讲述了一位不知名的叙述者（爱德华·诺顿饰）的故事，他是一名保险代理人，遇到了一位名叫泰勒·德登（布拉德·皮特饰）的神秘肥皂推销员，并为幻灭的人们创办了一个地下搏击俱乐部。

正如您对这部如此坚韧的电影所希望的那样，这张 4K 光盘的 DTS-HD 5.1 MA 配乐有很多值得喜欢的地方。 在打斗场景中，拳击和碰撞具有真实的冲击力，感觉每一点都像场景本身一样令人疲惫不堪。 更发自内心的声音，比如脂肪袋裂开的声音，既可怕又真实，听起来细节令人担忧。 电影的大部分时间里，旁白的讲话都非常清晰，与配乐和其他效果很好地平衡。

同样，这是另一种在某些场景中具有真正身临其境的感觉的混合，提供感知的高度效果。 在开场时，当摄像机从叙述者被枪指着的建筑物下降到下面的停车场时，微风的声音准确地跟随摄像机的轨迹，尽管缺乏高度通道，但仍产生了高度感。

吹熄

《井喷》讲述了杰克·特里（约翰·特拉沃尔塔饰）是一名音响技术员，他在为自己参与的一部低成本恐怖电影录制音频时无意中捕捉到了暗杀证据，从而卷入了一场谋杀/暗杀阴谋。

这张光盘的配乐如此有趣的原因在于，它使用的是 DTS-HD 2.0 环绕混音，而不是此列表中其他条目所采用的 DTS-HD 5.1 MA 环绕混音，保留了原始演示，但采用了我们今天可以提供的最佳质量混音。

虽然立体声听起来可能有限，但一些出色的声音设计意味着电影绝对让人感觉身临其境。 杰克在电影开场附近的公园里录制音频的场景最好地证明了这一点。

当他用麦克风捕捉音频时，风声和远处的交通声微妙地充满了整个空间。 当较大的音频出现时，例如猫头鹰的叫声，其他效果不会消失。 当汽车从桥上转向时，轮胎的刺耳声音从一侧移动到另一侧，再次充分利用了环绕声道。 当汽车冲破栅栏落入河中时，仍然产生了一些良好的影响。
